traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are implemented: - `@supports` is parsed and format-validated by valid-annotation-format (+ helpers), including mixed @story/@req/@supports usage. - Deep validation (valid-req-reference) checks each @supports requirement against the correct story file with per-story ID scoping, and error messages include the story path. - `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` both treat @supports as satisfying their respective annotation requirements while preserving legacy @story/@req behavior. - Extensive Jest tests explicitly tied to this story validate core, error, mixed-usage, and scoping behaviors; the whole test suite passes. - Documentation (migration guide, README, ADR 011) clearly describes @supports usage and migration, and confirms @supports as the canonical multi-story annotation. Therefore this story is fully implemented and verified.
